# VerifedDB

VerifedDB is an open marketplace where founders of small internet businesses (SaaS, mobile apps, digital products) list their startups for sale and buyers contact them directly.

- Revenue figures come from the founder's payment provider (Stripe or RevenueCat), read with a key the founder supplies at the time of verification. Each figure shows when it was last verified.
- Revenue (last 30 days) includes one-time payments and is gross of fees. MRR counts active subscriptions only. The multiple is asking price ÷ (30-day revenue × 12).
- VerifedDB is a listing and discovery platform. It is not a broker, escrow agent, or verifier of legal, tax or compliance matters. Buyers and sellers run due diligence, contracts, escrow and transfer themselves.
- Founders can list anonymously; anonymous listings hide the company name, logo, website, founding date and country.

## Pages

- Home and revenue leaderboard: /
- Startups for sale: /acquire
- A listing: /acquire/{listing-id}
- Sponsorships: /advertise
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
